name: PolicyDesk
author: kam27d

sections.description:
PolicyDesk is a professional-grade cookie consent management plugin designed to help WordPress websites achieve full compliance with GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act), LGPD (Brazil), and other global privacy regulations.

Why Choose PolicyDesk Over Basic PolicyDesk Plugins?

While many cookie notice plugins offer basic compliance, PolicyDesk goes beyond with professional-grade features. We implement the Intentional Consent framework, which eliminates dark patterns and ensures equal prominence for Accept, Decline, and Preferences options – a requirement for true GDPR compliance. With full Google Consent Mode v2 integration, automatic script blocking, intelligent cookie scanning, and comprehensive analytics dashboard, PolicyDesk provides everything you need for professional privacy compliance.

What Makes Us Different:

  • Intentional Consent Framework – Unlike basic plugins, we offer 3 equal buttons (Accept None, Some, All) that comply with GDPR’s equal choice principle
  • Google Consent Mode v2 – Full implementation with all consent parameters, not just basic integration
  • Automatic Cookie Scanner – Automatically detects and categorizes cookies on your website (most plugins require manual entry)
  • Analytics Dashboard – Track consent rates, export records, and generate compliance reports
  • Automatic Script Blocking – Blocks third-party scripts before consent (many plugins only show notices)
  • Default Configurations – One-click GDPR, CCPA, and Basic templates for instant setup

Key Compliance Features:

  • GDPR-Ready Features – Equal choice principle, granular consent, consent duration control, privacy paper, and consent record storage (Note: Plugin provides tools to help with GDPR compliance, but does not guarantee compliance)
  • CCPA-Ready Features – “Do Not Sell” option, privacy contact information, and data subject request forms (Note: Plugin provides tools to help with CCPA compliance, but does not guarantee compliance)
  • Google Consent Mode v2 – Full implementation with all consent parameters for Google Analytics 4
  • Intentional Consent – 3 equal buttons (Accept None, Some, All) that comply with GDPR equal choice principle
  • Automatic Script Blocking – Blocks third-party scripts (Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, etc.) before consent
  • Cookie Scanner – Automatically detects and categorizes cookies on your website
  • Analytics Dashboard – Track consent rates, export records, and generate compliance reports
  • Fully Customizable – Customize colors, text, layout, position, and styling to match your brand
  • Accessibility – WCAG/ADA compliant with keyboard navigation and screen reader support

Perfect for e-commerce sites, blogs, business websites, and any WordPress site that needs to comply with privacy regulations while maintaining a great user experience.

Important Legal Disclaimer

This plugin provides tools and features to help website owners implement cookie consent management in accordance with privacy regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and LGPD. However, this plugin does not guarantee legal compliance. Compliance with privacy regulations depends on many factors beyond the scope of this plugin, including:

  • Proper configuration of the plugin settings
  • Accurate cookie categorization
  • Complete and accurate privacy policy
  • Legal review of your privacy practices
  • Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations

You should consult with a qualified legal professional to ensure your website fully complies with all applicable privacy regulations. The developers of this plugin are not responsible for any legal consequences resulting from the use or misuse of this plugin.

Key Features

  • Intentional Consent Framework – 3 equal buttons (Accept None, Some, All) that eliminate dark patterns and comply with GDPR equal choice principle
  • Google Consent Mode v2 – Full implementation with all consent parameters (analytics_storage, ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization) for Google Analytics 4
  • Analytics Dashboard – Comprehensive consent analytics with charts, category acceptance rates, and export functionality
  • Consent Triggers – Automatic consent on scroll or close for improved user experience
  • Default Configurations – One-click GDPR, CCPA, and Basic templates for quick setup
  • Automatic Script Blocking – Blocks third-party scripts before consent is given
  • Cookie Categories – Granular control with 7 cookie categories (Essential, Performance, Analytics, Marketing, Social, Unclassified, Preferences)
  • Privacy Features – Privacy Paper, Privacy Contact, Consent Duration Selector, Consent Metrics Display
  • Fully Customizable – Customize colors, text, layout, position, and styling
  • Multiple Layouts – Banner, Box, and Modal layouts
  • Responsive Design – Mobile-friendly and accessible
  • Database Storage – Stores consent records for compliance

GDPR Compliance

  • Equal choice principle (Decline as prominent as Accept)
  • Intentional Consent framework
  • Granular cookie category control
  • Consent duration selector (max 6 months)
  • Privacy Paper section
  • Privacy Contact information
  • Consent metrics display
  • Automatic script blocking
  • Consent record storage

CCPA Compliance

  • “Do Not Sell” option
  • Privacy contact information
  • Data subject request forms
  • Consent record export

Developer Features

  • Custom events for integration
  • Shortcodes for cookie settings and status
  • Hooks and filters for extensibility
  • AJAX-powered consent saving
  • WordPress Privacy Policy sync ready

Development

Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Please follow WordPress coding standards and submit pull requests through GitHub.

Support

For support, please visit the plugin support forum or contact the developer.

Credits

Developed by kam27d (https://PolicyDesk.co/)
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “PolicyDesk”
  4. Click “Install Now”
  5. Click “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  4. Click “Upload Plugin”
  5. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  6. Click “Activate”

Configuration

  1. Go to PolicyDesk → Settings
  2. Configure your cookie notice message and styling
  3. Enable cookie categories you want to offer
  4. Set up Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy links
  5. Choose a default configuration template (GDPR, CCPA, or Basic)
  6. Save your settings
sections.faq:
Does this plugin comply with GDPR?

Yes, PolicyDesk is designed to help you comply with GDPR requirements including equal choice principle, granular consent, consent duration control, and consent record storage.

Does this support Google Consent Mode v2?

Yes, the plugin includes full Google Consent Mode v2 implementation with all consent parameters for Google Analytics 4.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes, you can customize colors, text, layout, position, border radius, and more through the admin settings.

Does it block scripts before consent?

Yes, the plugin can automatically block third-party scripts (Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, etc.) before consent is given.

Can I export consent records?

Yes, the Analytics dashboard includes export functionality for CSV and JSON formats with date range filtering.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive and works on all devices.

Does it support multiple languages?

The plugin is translation-ready and uses the WordPress translation system. Translation files can be added to the /languages directory.
